normal_batch.timing_scope: Same instrumented model.step path, including diagnostic copies and RNG digests. Alternating method order. These are full diagnostic replay costs, not an optimized boundary-kernel microbenchmark.
normal_batch.coupling_scope: Identical scenario, frozen weights, initialization and actor seed per replay. After a numerical branch changes random consumption, trajectories evolve naturally; divergence is recorded rather than forcing path equality.
normal_batch.control_difference_scope: Recorded drift/logit/threshold differences follow each closed-loop history. After action or state divergence they include downstream effects, not only local root roundoff.
